svg.title: Preserving a working uConsole CM4 image
svg.desc: Record the running image, make a recoverable whole-device backup, and run the read-only preflight. If an optional install is necessary, keep the script's configuration archive, inspect the package plan, and retest the device after the change.

g.text: Preserving a working uConsole CM4 image
If an optional installation is needed
Stop if hardware or sources fail
Keep the configuration archive, review the package plan, then retest.
The configuration archive contains selected settings. Keep the device image for storage recovery.
